review_text: Died to the same room of monsters ten times. The difficulty spike on floor 2 is brutal and not fun.
Way too hard. Enemies hit like trucks and there are barely any health potions.
Love the exploration, finding hidden treasure rooms is the best part.
Every level feels the same after an hour. Same corridors, same monsters, very repetitive.
Traps are completely unfair, you step on a tile and lose half your health with no warning.
Combat is tense in a good way. Every fight matters.
I keep getting lost. The maps are confusing and I spend half my time walking back the way I came.
Too much backtracking to find the key for the locked door. Tedious.
Great dungeon crawler, but the difficulty could be a little more forgiving early on.
Nothing to find off the main path. Empty rooms with no reward for exploring.
Way too easy once you learn to just run past everything. No challenge at all.
The key and door puzzles are satisfying when they click.
Brutal difficulty, punishing deaths, I gave up after an hour.
Repetitive layouts and the same enemy placement over and over.
Rewarding exploration, I love collecting all the coins in a level.
Spike traps everywhere on the only route. It's not challenge, it's cheap.
The levels are a maze with dead ends everywhere. Confusing design.
Good pacing, careful players are rewarded over people who rush.
Too hard, not enough healing, monsters guard every corridor.
Gets boring fast, every run plays out the same way.
Unfair deaths from traps you cannot avoid.
Love that playing carefully actually pays off.
Short levels with nothing to do except walk to the exit. Too easy.
The difficulty is insane. Got wrecked by three monsters in a row.
Lots of pointless walking back and forth. Level layout needs shortcuts.
Tense fights, great atmosphere, fun to explore every corner.
Repetitive, grindy and samey. Needs more variety.
No reason to explore, side rooms are empty.
Punishing difficulty with almost no potions. Frustrating.
Challenging but fair once you learn the patterns.
Traps placed in narrow corridors you are forced to walk through. Unfair.
Dead ends and backtracking everywhere, I got lost constantly.
Monsters block every path and the game is way too hard for new players.
Exploring for treasure is addictive.
Feels repetitive after the first few levels.
Too easy, I never felt in danger.
Love how risky shortcuts give you more coins.
Health potions are too rare and the enemies are too strong.
Layouts force you to retrace your steps too often.
Satisfying to clear a level without taking damage by playing carefully.
Every floor is the same monster gauntlet. Very monotonous.
Hard for the wrong reasons: random trap damage decides runs.
Difficulty is all over the place, some rooms are impossible.
Fun dungeon design with secrets to find.
Empty, lifeless levels with no rewards for going off the path.
Got lost in the map again. Needs better level design.
Way too hard, quit after dying to the first room repeatedly.
Tough but rewarding, the challenge keeps me coming back.
